name: transcribe-audio
title: Transcribe Audio
description: Transcribe audio and video files with OpenAI, Deepgram, or ElevenLabs. Export to Markdown, plain text, or SRT. FFmpeg is used for format conversion when needed.
author: mouxy

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Used when OpenAI is selected as the transcription provider.

preferences.name: deepgramApiKey
preferences.title: Deepgram API Key
preferences.description: Used when Deepgram is selected as the transcription provider.

preferences.name: elevenlabsApiKey
preferences.title: ElevenLabs API Key
preferences.description: Used when ElevenLabs is selected as the transcription provider.

preferences.name: historyEnabled
preferences.title: Save Transcription History
preferences.description: Store recent transcriptions locally so they can be viewed again later.
preferences.label: Keep transcription history

preferences.name: historyRetentionDays
preferences.title: History Retention
preferences.description: How long to keep saved transcriptions.

preferences.name: historyMaxEntries
preferences.title: Maximum History Entries
preferences.description: Maximum number of transcriptions to keep.

commands.name: transcribe
commands.title: Transcribe Audio
commands.description: Transcribe the selected audio or video file.

preferences.name: defaultProvider
preferences.title: Default Provider
preferences.description: Which provider to use by default.

preferences.name: defaultAudioType
preferences.title: Default Audio Type
preferences.description: What kind of recording this is by default.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Leave empty for automatic language detection. Use ISO 639-1 codes (e.g. en, pt, es) where supported.
